The issuer shows moderate credit quality: profitability appears solid with EBIT of 622M on 4,066M revenue (roughly mid-teens margin), and retained earnings are positive. However, liquidity is tight (current ratio of 0.99) and leverage is meaningful (total liabilities of 15,009M vs. equity of 10,004M), which increases refinancing and downside risk. Overall, this supports a lower investment-grade rating rather than a higher tier.  

DECISION: BBB-
